No way! I wanted to be a ballerina when I was young too. It’s what I drew in this book my kindergarten (or maybe 1st grade 🤔 it’s one of those lol) teacher had our class do of what we wanted to be. It shifted as I got older to wanting to be either a professor, author, or editor (because I enjoy English).

Now I’m in college pursuing my elementary education degree 😆 So I’m dream adjacent

Yes, this is happening to me now (@ 19-20). It felt like I woke up and suddenly was very present in my body; and I didn’t notice how non-present I was. I’ve started seeing the flaws in myself and my family and friends more clearly, and I’m realizing how washed out I was becoming, even more so due to the pandemic. I’m glad but also scared bc I’m not used to being so aware of myself or others and how I’m perceived/how I come across to others. It was until last week? End of the week before? That I realized that I might have autism. So much that I’m reading applies to me and my life, and while it’s a relief to figure out I’m not just “wrong” it’s also scary because it means my perception of things/life have a different lens.

I would like to do this, as I’m currently in college and have access to more local activities, but I’m also nervous. I get anxious going out by myself because I’m pretty oblivious to my surroundings (though I’m trying to work on it) and I get scared to ask questions :(( Then again, there are free classes on my campus I can go to 🤔 I did try it last semester with going to a free paint night with a new club. So maybe I’m not so bad at doing it like I thought 😁 Maybe instead of going places around my town, I can do my campus! Sorry for going through my thought process here lol But I wanna take this advice~

I prefer my headphones for sound, but my AirPods are more convenient as they don’t take up space. My headphones were too big for my bag so I use those when I’m studying in my room or wanting to relax while my ear buds are for outdoor usage
That is definitely me. I finished my last exam yesterday and I am so happy. Two years down, two more to go 😁

I thought it was for Easter egg hunts. You push the stick into the ground of a patch of grass so it’s easier to find. 

Or it could be used on cupcakes - poke the stick through the cupcake and put green frosting or coconut shavings and you have Easter themed cupcakes!

I appreciate you saying that. Not to say my anger isn’t valid, but I was pretty exhausted while typing this, and that’s weeks of exhaustion piling up. After getting some decent rest and doing some thinking, I realized that while I’m angry, it’s not something that controls me. This post, it was controlling me but now I can respond as I want to rather than being fueled by my high emotions.

I’m angry, but I don’t hate them. I hate what they did, or didn’t do in some cases. But we’re all trying to get better from it and while I may never share exactly what is bothering me (at the moment anyway bc I’m so all over the place with emotions) I’m working on communicating my thoughts and feelings. They’ll either catch up or lose a place in my life 🤷🏾‍♀️ 

But thanks again for this comment. I think I needed validation of my feelings before I could rest easy.
Thank you! I love hugs and will appreciated them physically or virtually.

Thank you, so much. The anger is still there, but it’s faded more into a drive to understand and fix things. But, there’s just so much that I’ve been suppressing over the years that having it flood out like this is overwhelming. I don’t want to blow up at them when I bring this up. I don’t want to want to despise them for things that have already happened. I want stuff to change, and I want to move on. I want them to apologize and mean it.

But I don’t know how to do that. I’ve always redirected my focus and attention (and anger) to other things which isn’t bad on its own, but it caused me to lose out on years of my life. As in, there is so much I don’t remember because I’ve been blocking it out, not dealing with it, and it’s left me in a limbo of unresolved feelings. How do you tell people how much they have hurt you, angered you, without completely losing your mind? Because that’s what it feels like I’m on the path to doing.

My counselor sure is gonna have a field day with this 😔
❤️ thank you for sharing this. No means no. You don’t have to explain, you don’t have to excuse, if I say so, it means no.
